title: Scope-Creep Pricer (Change Orders)
description: Turn scope creep into a priced change order: compare a fixed fee against the hours actually worked to get the baseline rate, the effective rate, and the effective-rate decay percentage. Prices the unpriced creep hours at your baseline rate, produces the change-order price at standard and rush multipliers (1.0x, 1.25x, 1.5x), and checks the effective rate against a walk-away floor with a renegotiate-or-decline verdict. Pure arithmetic on user-entered project figures; nothing stored.
data_vintage: Pure arithmetic on user-entered project figures (fee, quoted scope hours, actual hours, floor rate, rush multiplier). No market feeds, no rate tables, no stored data.

mcp_tool_definition.description: Compare a freelance fixed fee against the hours actually worked: baseline rate, effective rate, and decay percentage; the unpriced leak in dollars; the change-order price at baseline and rush multipliers; and a walk-away floor verdict.
